name: digitalsamba/claude-code-video-toolkit
description: A 24-skill video production collection under .claude/skills/ covering AI video generation and video editing. The sample read, Remotion, guides Remotion-based video work. Setup uses Claude Code slash commands after cloning.
install: git clone, then Claude Code slash commands /setup and /video, with Node.js 22+ and Claude Code required and uv recommended for Python tools. Do not reproduce the README uv pipe suggestion; point to the official uv install docs or a package manager instead.
